title: Deformation Theory of Monoid Schemes I
summary: The aim of this paper is to develop a deformation theory of monoid schemes, generalising the approach developed by Grillet. The core idea of this approach is to introduce the notion of a system of abelian groups, as the naive approach to exactness does not work for monoids. We first study the case of monoid sheaves (functors over a poset into the category of monoids) and prove a classification theorem in this setting, showing that the coextensions of a monoid functor with a system of abelian groups is a symmetric categorical group and equivalent to the one obtained by the abelian group…
